Interface CustomAttachmentSpec<O,C>

Type Parameters:
O - owner type (whatever the consumer's persistence anchors on)
C - content type (what the consumer stores per slot group)
public interface CustomAttachmentSpec<O,C>
Implemented by consumers to extend storage attachments. It has two uses:
  1. Other owner types. Consumers whose owner type isn't covered by the four built-in factories (ephemeral, player-attached, block-scoped, item-attached) supply their own save, load and dirty hooks in this spec and wrap it with StorageAttachment.custom(spec).
  2. Decorating vanilla menus. Consumers who decorate vanilla menus through ScreenPanelAdapter don't go through CustomContainerMenu, so they don't get its save and load lifecycle. They use a custom spec and trigger save and load from their own mixin.

The library never knows what O is. The spec handles all owner-specific persistence, and the library only makes the lifecycle calls.

The content type C is up to the consumer. For the common case, NonNullList<ItemStack>, the spec is simple. For structured content (records, wrappers) the spec methods do the conversions.

  • Method Details

    • read

      C read(O owner)
      Reads the stored content for this owner. The result is what later Storage reads see. If nothing has been saved yet, return a default from defaultFactory().

    • write

      void write(O owner, C content)
      Writes the content for this owner. Called after changes (through Storage.setStack) to save them.

      A spec backed by a Fabric attachment typically calls owner.setAttached(attachmentType, content) here.

    • markDirty

      void markDirty(O owner)
      Marks the owner as needing to be saved. For block entities, call be.setChanged(). For entities and players this is often empty, since Fabric saves attachment changes on its own.

    • defaultFactory

      C defaultFactory()
      Returns new default content for when nothing is stored yet. For a NonNullList<ItemStack> spec with slotCount slots: 
        () -> NonNullList.withSize(slotCount, ItemStack.EMPTY)

    • toItemList

      net.minecraft.core.NonNullList<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack> toItemList(C content)
      Converts stored content to a mutable NonNullList for the storage. If C is already NonNullList<ItemStack>, return the content itself.

    • fromItemList

      C fromItemList(net.minecraft.core.NonNullList<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack> items)
      Converts a changed item list back to the content, keeping any fields that are not item stacks. The storage calls it after each setStack so the change is saved through write(O, C). If C is already NonNullList<ItemStack>, return the list itself.

    • slotCount

      int slotCount()
      How many slots this content holds, reported as the storage's size.

    • id

      net.minecraft.resources.Identifier id()
      Identifier for this spec, for debug logging and to tell apart specs that share an owner type.
